北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京很冷哦，体感 -8℃。注意保暖，别着凉！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is quite chilly, feels like -8℃. Stay warm and bundled up!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴好，体感 3℃，微凉。外出记得添衣哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and cool, feels like 3℃. Remember to dress warmly!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阳光正好，体感 4℃。注意温差，穿暖和点。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny, feels like 4℃. Mind the temperature difference and dress warm.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴朗舒适，体感 13℃。享受好天气哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and pleasant, feels like 13℃. Enjoy the lovely weather!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 14℃。天气舒适，注意补充水分。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 14℃. Comfortable weather, stay hydrated.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴冷，体感 0℃，风力 4 级。记得防风保暖哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny but cold, feels like 0℃ with 4-level wind. Stay warm and wind-protected!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云微冷，体感 -1℃。注意防寒，多喝热水。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and chilly, feels like -1℃. Keep warm and drink plenty of hot water.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴冷，体感 3℃。湿度高，注意防潮也别着凉。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and cold, feels like 3℃. High humidity, keep warm and dry.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 7℃。出门记得带伞，谨防感冒。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 7℃. Bring an umbrella if going out, and watch out for colds.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴冷，体感 0℃。出门多穿点，注意皮肤保湿。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and cold, feels like 0℃. Dress warmly and moisturize your skin.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆大雾，体感 7℃。能见度低，出行请注意安全！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy, feels like 7℃. Low visibility, please travel safely!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，体感 -27℃，大雾。务必注意防寒保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels like -27℃, and foggy. Please keep very warm!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -27℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴冷，体感 -11℃，风力 4 级。多穿几层，注意防风。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and very cold, feels like -11℃ with 4-level wind. Layer up and stay wind-protected.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 6℃。气候宜人，但早晚温差大。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, feels like 6℃. Pleasant weather, but mind the day-night temperature difference.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 8℃，风力 4 级。风大，注意防风保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 8℃ with 4-level wind. It's windy, keep warm and protected.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 -4℃，风力 5 级。风寒效应强，多添衣。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like -4℃ with 5-level wind. Strong wind chill, dress warmly.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -6℃，风力 6 级。风力很强，务必防风！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -6℃ with 6-level wind. Very strong winds, be sure to stay wind-protected!
